main.description: A self-published declaration that this identity maintains an MCP server. One record per server, on the publisher's own PDS. The atlas at mcp.waow.tech is one view over these records; anyone can build another.

description.description: What the server does, one paragraph.

url.description: Remote endpoint for hosted servers (streamable HTTP). Omit for local-only servers.

manifest.description: URL of a machine-readable manifest (e.g. a raw fastmcp.json) describing how to run the server from source.

tools.description: Tool names the server exposes. Advisory; crawlers may verify by connecting.
